title: Foundations post-test
description: Check that you can set a search pattern and localize a finding before claiming your certificate.

questions.prompt: Before zooming in on a subtle finding, what should you do first?
options: Narrow the window to bone settings immediately
Set your search pattern across the full series
Skip to the last slice and work backwards only
Disable comparison series to reduce distraction
questions.rationale: A structured search pattern prevents missed findings before you zoom or window in.

questions.prompt: Why adjust window/level when reviewing a region of interest?
options: It brings out subtle density differences that a wide window can hide
It permanently crops the series for other learners
It replaces the need for a comparison series
questions.rationale: Window/level is a display transform — use it to reveal contrast that a default window can obscure.

questions.prompt: Click the authored finding marker on the overview image (left-center of the viewport).
